title: Random survival forest predicts 1-year mortality after acute coronary syndrome
summary: Random survival forest and DeepSurv were compared with Cox models on the ACSIS survey and externally validated on the UK MINAP data. RSF performed best with Harrell C-index 0.924 on the test set and 0.811 externally (IPCW 0.844, Brier 0.093), against 0.689-0.790 for Cox models in validation. The study is retrospective and the gap between training and external results needs prospective evaluation.
